# Public OpenPGP keys of the automataIA APT repository.
#
# automata-archive-keyring.pgp is generated by scripts/keygen (export of
# the repository signing key) and committed here so it can be:
#   - served from public/ for manual download
#   - embedded into the automata-archive-keyring .deb
#   - used by scripts/repo-test to verify InRelease signatures
#
# The PRIVATE key never leaves ~/.local/share/automata-apt/gnupg (or the
# GitHub Actions secrets) and must never be committed.
